text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in gateway 5xxs observed. 502/504 rate ~17% over last 60s in eu-west for service 'inference-gateway'. Severity: P1. Auto-pager sent.

sam (oncall): oncall here, paging dan and priya. pulling graphs. :rotating_light:

dan: ack. I'm on. checking recent deploys and proxy health. Will post next steps in 30s.

priya: I see a config rollout to gw-config-2 completed ~3m ago. small percent of hosts updated. Noticed increased latency behind those hosts in logs.

sam (oncall): confirm pausing any in-progress rollouts. Priya, can you isolate which subset?

priya: isolating now. hosts: gw-2a,b,c show higher 502s. traffic split ~12% to that pool.

dan: initiating emergency rollback of gw-config-2 to previous revision. command: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/gw-config-2 --to-revision=4`
Command output: `deployment "gw-config-2" rolled back to revision 4`

kevin: while rollback runs, enabling fallback routing to stable pool to reduce blast radius. command: `redwood route set fallback --service inference-gateway --to=gw-stable --region=eu-west`
Command output: `fallback route enabled, estimated shift 8-10%`

incident-bot: notice: frontend circuit-breaker tripped on several edge proxies; automatic short-circuiting active on 5 hosts.

elaine: increasing upstream timeout to 30s and bumping connection pool for envoy on edge tier to reduce cascading 504s. command: `envoy routes update --service inference-gateway --timeout=30s --conn-pool=200`

priya: customer impact snapshot: ~12% of user requests in eu-west receiving 502/504. Top impacted customers: acme-inc, zoomly, docsplus (tickets: https://zendesk.example/ACME-123, ZML-456). No orders processed for a small percentage of requests.

dan: rollback finished. Observability: 5xx rate down from 17% -> 6% and trending down over last 2m. Latency back to baseline on gw-stable. Keeping watches for 15m.

sam (oncall): great, keep open channel. escalate to SRE lead if rate doesn't drop under 2% in 20m. Add postmortem owner.

kevin: disabling circuit-breaker short-circuit on two recovered proxies. command: `opsctl proxy resume --id=gw-2a`

incident-bot: INCIDENT state -> MITIGATED (monitoring). Root-cause investigation and postmortem assigned to dan. PagerDuty: auto-resolve triggered.

sam (oncall): thanks everyone. action items: 1) Dan to capture timeline + revert diff, 2) Priya to audit rollout gating, 3) Elaine to review proxy timeout defaults. We'll update status page if customers ask. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Pager cleared for incident 3024689123. Follow-up: schedule 1-hour postmortem sync in #incidents-postmortems.

sam (oncall): closing live triage. We'll keep this thread open for 30m for follow-ups.
